responseText:
Where are the guards? 

Those grab-things swarmed over us and stole my Hearth-helper.

Call it a doll and I'll clock you. That's my grandfather - stitched by my Ma with a stone from his own forge inside - and I want it back! I'm not leaving this spot until I get it!
name: ANV_FTUE_BF_0016_Dunzendoll_Pebblepocket_1_Response
